title: Rideable Rock
description: It's not just a boulder, it's a rock! The pioneers would be proud!
body:
It's not just a boulder... IT'S A ROCK! The pioneers used to ride these babies for miles!
This resource pack turns Horses into _**ROCKS!**_ :D
If you've ever wanted to ride rocks then this pack is for you! :D
![The pioneers would be proud :')](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/74970ba4a8c1ed750d723a8ad1ccd3f84780f0bd.png)
